name: Staff quartermaster lever (samples orphan_usd_day, the $/day of Fly machines with no job row plus idle Orgo capacity; at level act, records one lever row per orphan pool machine, then probes it (dry) or stops it through bin/fly-idle-reaper.sh act)

knobs.note: BH-10123 test seam: epoch seconds used as the clock, only with HARNESS_TEST_SANDBOX=1 and only all-digit values. NOT settable from the control plane. The real knobs are settings rows: staff.quartermaster.level, staff.quartermaster.idle_min, staff.quartermaster.lever_dry_run, staff.quartermaster.stops_max_run, staff.quartermaster.snapshot_max_age_min, staff.quartermaster.act_timeout_s.
BH-10123 test seam: 1 = load qm_action_verdict, qm_orphans and qm_candidates and return before the run. NOT settable from the control plane.
Test seam gate: bin/staff/quartermaster-lever.sh honors QM_LEVER_NOW only when this is 1 (the test harness sets it). Never set on a box, and NOT settable from the control plane.
